acceptanceCriteria: A recorded decision states whether the Claude Code adapter gains a function-hook module, with the host versions observed and the early-access limit retained.
If accepted, the host-adapter spec gains requirements with stable IDs covering coexistence with the command hooks, no double delivery, and the untrusted-data envelope on every new injection surface.

A prototype hooks module passes `claude plugin validate` and `claude plugin test` on a host that has them, and a live session shows the stale-snapshot degradation as an operator-visible status with an explicit refresh action.
compatibility.json records the function-hook surface separately from the command-hook PASS, as NOT_RUN until a black-box lifecycle run exists.
body:
Claude Code now loads function-hook plugins (mods): a hooks module named in hooks/hooks.json under `modules`, exporting register(on, options), with in-process hooks ($, e, next), a 10,000 ms per-dispatch budget, $.process.run, $.ui (status, toast, pane, AbovePrompt band), $.command.register, $.clock timers, $.state/$.store, and events the command hooks do not expose (prompt.context, prompt.section, session.compact, tool.call, tool.check, turn.complete, agent.spawn, classic.*). Observed 2026-10-04 in the desktop session engine 2.1.286 (declaration file written by the engine); the API is labelled early access and moves between releases. The `claude` on PATH is 2.1.267, has no `plugin test`, and its `plugin validate` reads only the manifest of the shipped plugin.

The shipped corvint@corvint plugin (adapter 0.2.x) is seven command hooks at a 1-2 s timeout calling `corvint adapter claude-code <event>`. Friction reproduced in the same session: SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit both degraded with `corvint-event-rejected:dogfood-event-index-snapshot-stale`, and the only remediation is prose asking for a manual `corvint index --if-stale`.

Candidate uses, each needing its own spec decision: (1) an operator-visible status entry and a /corvint command or button that runs `corvint index --if-stale` as an explicit, operator-started action, so invariant 4 and the no-automatic-refresh rule hold; (2) session.compact to carry the compaction pin in-process and verify it on the way up, replacing the PreCompact/PostCompact pair that has no live cycle evidence; (3) tool.call on Read/Grep and agent.spawn for the point-of-use and SubagentStart ideas already ticketed; (4) a read-only pane rendering the last packet, degradation code and frontier state. Constraints to settle first: the module has no Node and no DOM, so it stays a thin shim over the Go binary; the mod path must coexist with the command hooks for hosts without function hooks and must not double-fire; untrusted repository data must stay enveloped when it enters prompt.context or session.append; a mod carries no Frontier authority.
title: hosts: evaluate a Claude Code function-hook module (mod) for the corvint plugin
